_comment_fixture: NINA fixture exercising every drop / unsupported code-path: (1) a plug-in script node with no Skotiq analog, (2) a SafetyMonitor trigger NINA emits as a watchdog Skotiq doesn't model, (3) a SmartExposure composite node, (4) an explicit Annotation (decorative drop), (5) a disabled exposure (drop reason: disabled), and (6) a SwitchFilter with no resolvable Filter name (which the mapper turns into an unsupported record). Each unsupported entry must show up individually in ImportResult.unsupportedNodes — the importer must surface ALL of them, not just the first.
Name: Edge-case import fixture

Items._comment_supported_exposure: Normal supported exposure — ensures other unsupported nodes don't poison the whole import.
Items.Name: Light

Items._comment_plugin_script: Third-party plugin (PowerUps / Hocus Focus / NINA Plugin Marketplace). NINA emits the plugin's fully-qualified $type. No Skotiq equivalent — must land in unsupportedNodes.
Items.Name: Run user PowerShell hook

Items._comment_safety_monitor: Safety-monitor watchdog: NINA has it, Skotiq does not yet (audit §#9). Should surface as unsupported, not be silently dropped.
Items.Name: Safety Monitor Watchdog

Items._comment_smart_exposure: SmartExposure is a NINA composite (filter + exposure + dither in one node). Skotiq models these as separate nodes, so the composite is reported unsupported. Users are expected to expand it manually post-import.
Items.Name: Smart Composite

Items._comment_annotation: Annotation/Note is decorative — Skotiq drops it with DropReason.decorative (no unsupported entry).
Items.Name: Reminder: check focuser temp before each run

Items._comment_disabled_exposure: Enabled=false should drop the node with DropReason.disabled — children of a disabled container would also be re-parented in the mapper, but here it's a leaf so it simply drops.
Items.Name: Disabled rejected exposure

Items._comment_filter_no_name: SwitchFilter is recognized but the Filter payload has neither a _name nor a Position field — _extractFilter returns null and the mapper turns the FilterChange into a 'null filter name' unsupported record at construct() time.
Items.Name: Broken Filter Change
